**Wire verb `peptidoform fragments`**: Fetch a UniProt entry with its annotated modifications, digest it, and return every peptidoform with its fragment ions, plus a census of which annotations were applied.

# Wraps

- [`ProteinDbLoader.LoadProteinXML`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/ProteinDbLoader.cs) in `mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/ProteinDbLoader.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`Loaders.LoadUniprot`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/Loaders.cs) in `mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/Loaders.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`Protein.Digest`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Proteomics/Protein/Protein.cs) in `mzLib/Proteomics/Protein/Protein.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`DigestionParams`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Proteomics/ProteolyticDigestion/DigestionParams.cs) in `mzLib/Proteomics/ProteolyticDigestion/DigestionParams.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`ProteaseDictionary`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Proteomics/ProteolyticDigestion/ProteaseDictionary.cs) in `mzLib/Proteomics/ProteolyticDigestion/ProteaseDictionary.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`proteases.tsv (each protease name's cleavage motif)`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Proteomics/ProteolyticDigestion/proteases.tsv) in `mzLib/Proteomics/ProteolyticDigestion/proteases.tsv` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`PeptideWithSetModifications.Fragment`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Proteomics/ProteolyticDigestion/PeptideWithSetModifications.cs) in `mzLib/Proteomics/ProteolyticDigestion/PeptideWithSetModifications.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`

# Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accession` (wire `--accession`) | `string` | required | — | — | A UniProtKB accession, e.g. P02768; fetched from rest.uniprot.org. The bridge checks only that it is not blank (the bindings upper-case it and check its shape first). UniProt's 400 or 404 becomes a usage error. |
| `protease` (wire `--protease`) | `string` | absent | — | `a key of mzLib's ProteaseDictionary` | mzLib protease name. Absent, the bridge sends none and DigestionParams' default applies ("trypsin" at d10017ce). The names and what each one cuts are mzLib's, defined in proteases.tsv. At d10017ce "trypsin" is K\|,R\|, which cuts after K and R even before P; "trypsin\|P" is K\[P\]\|,R\[P\]\|, where \[P\] marks a residue that prevents the cut, so it does not cut before P. These are not MaxQuant's or Mascot's names: their "Trypsin/P" ignores the proline rule. On serum albumin (P02768) "trypsin" gives 202 distinct peptides and "trypsin\|P" gives 195 (other options absent). |
| `dissociation` (wire `--dissociation`) | `string` | `HCD` | — | `a mzLib DissociationType name, case-insensitive: HCD, CID, ETD, EThcD, ...` | Which fragment series to generate: HCD and CID give b and y; ETD gives c and zDot. Absent, HCD. mzLib's Fragment requires a type and names no default, so HCD is the bridge's own stop-gap until mzLib names one. mzLib\#1488 asks for HCD, which MetaMorpheus's CommonParameters already defaults to. |
| `terminus` (wire `--terminus`) | `string` | absent | — | `a mzLib FragmentationTerminus name, case-insensitive: Both, N, C` | Which fragment termini to generate. It is also passed to DigestionParams. Absent, DigestionParams' default applies (Both at d10017ce), to the digest and to the fragments. |
| `modifications` (wire `--no-modifications`) | `flag` | `false` | — | — | Digest the bare sequence: UniProt's modifications are discarded but its signal-peptide and propeptide boundaries are kept (pyMzLib\#8), so the backbone peptide list is unchanged and only the modified variants go away. A clean control. |
| `missed_cleavages` (wire `--missed-cleavages`) | `int` | absent | cleavage sites | `>= 0` | Maximum missed cleavage sites per peptide (DigestionParams maxMissedCleavages). Absent, DigestionParams' default applies (2 at d10017ce). |
| `min_length` (wire `--min-length`) | `int` | absent | residues | `>= 1` | Shortest peptide kept (DigestionParams minPeptideLength). Absent, DigestionParams' default applies (7 at d10017ce). That default drops shorter peptides silently: histone H3.1 (P68431) keeps 49 of the 96 peptides it gives at 1 (distinct start and end, other options absent). Pass 1 for every peptide. |
| `max_length` (wire `--max-length`) | `int` | absent | residues | `>= 0` | Longest peptide kept (DigestionParams maxPeptideLength); 0 means unbounded. Absent, DigestionParams' default applies (unbounded at d10017ce). |
| `max_modifications` (wire `--max-mods`) | `int` | absent | modifications | `>= 0` | Maximum modifications per peptidoform (DigestionParams maxModsForPeptides). Absent, DigestionParams' default applies (2 at d10017ce). Isoforms grow combinatorially: histone H3.1's 49 peptides give 2,419 peptidoforms at 2 and 6,580 at 3, where 2 peptide positions already reach the isoform cap (other options absent). |
| `max_isoforms` (wire `--max-isoforms`) | `int` | absent | peptidoforms | `>= 1` | Cap on modification isoforms per peptide position (DigestionParams maxModificationIsoforms). Absent, DigestionParams' default applies (1024 at d10017ce). mzLib truncates SILENTLY at the cap; peptides\_at\_isoform\_cap reports it. |

# Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accession` | `string` | — | never | The accession UniProt returned. |
| `name` | `string` | — | yes: the entry records no entry name | UniProt entry name, e.g. ALBU\_HUMAN. |
| `full_name` | `string` | — | yes: the entry records no recommended name | Recommended protein name, e.g. Albumin. |
| `organism` | `string` | — | yes: the entry records no organism | Scientific name. |
| `sequence_length` | `int` | residues | never | Length of the full precursor sequence. |
| `modifications_applied` | `bool` | — | never | False under no-modifications. |
| `sites` (wire `annotated_modification_sites`) | `int` | residues | never | Distinct residue positions carrying at least one loaded modification. Not a modification count: K9me1/me2/me3/ac are four modifications at one site. |
| `applied` (wire `annotated_modifications_loaded`) | `int` | modifications | never | Modifications mzLib loaded onto the protein (summed over sites). Counted from the annotated entry, so unchanged by no-modifications. |
| `annotated` (wire `uniprot_annotated_features`) | `int` | features | never | Modification-like features in the XML: modified residue, glycosylation site, lipid moiety-binding region and cross-link. |
| `unresolved` (wire `unresolved_modifications`) | `string[]` | — | never | Modification names the entry annotates that could not be resolved against UniProt's ptmlist, sorted. These are dropped silently by mzLib otherwise. |
| `by_type` (wire `uniprot_features_by_type`) | `object[]` | — | never | {type, count, loaded} per feature type, sorted by type. loaded is true only for 'modified residue' and 'lipid moiety-binding region': mzLib drops the others on feature TYPE alone, before any mass lookup. |
| `protease` | `string` | — | never | The protease used: the one given, or DigestionParams' default. |
| `dissociation` | `string` | — | never | DissociationType name used: the one given, or HCD. |
| `terminus` | `string` | — | never | FragmentationTerminus name used: the one given, or DigestionParams' default. |
| `max_modifications` | `int` | modifications | never | max-mods as used: the value given, or DigestionParams' default. |
| `max_isoforms` (wire `max_modification_isoforms`) | `int` | peptidoforms | never | max-isoforms as used: the value given, or DigestionParams' default. |
| `peptides_at_cap` (wire `peptides_at_isoform_cap`) | `int` | peptide positions | never | Peptide positions (start, end) whose peptidoforms in mzLib's raw digest, counted before the bridge collapses the mzLib\#1108 duplicates, reached max-isoforms. Non-zero means the list is TRUNCATED. |
| wire `peptide_count` | `int` | peptidoforms | never | Entries in peptides. |
| `peptides` | `object[]` | — | never | One entry per distinct peptidoform (start, end, full sequence), in digestion order; fields under result.columns. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `base_sequence` | `string` | — | never | Bare residues. |
| `full_sequence` | `string` | — | never | mzLib full sequence with modifications inline, e.g. ...K\[UniProt:N6-succinyllysine on K\]. |
| `monoisotopic_mass` | `float` | Da | never | Neutral monoisotopic mass, modifications included. |
| `length` | `int` | residues | never | Peptide length. |
| `one_based_start` | `int` | — | never | First residue's position in the protein, 1-based. |
| `one_based_end` | `int` | — | never | Last residue's position in the protein, 1-based, inclusive. |
| `missed_cleavages` | `int` | cleavage sites | never | Missed cleavage sites spanned. |
| wire `modification_count` | `int` | modifications | never | Entries in modifications. |
| `fixed_charges` | `int` | charge | never | Formal charges the INTACT peptide carries before protonation (e.g. trimethyllysine's quaternary ammonium), recovered from each modification's formula-vs-recorded mass deficit in whole electrons. m/z at charge z is (monoisotopic\_mass + (z - fixed\_charges) \* 1.00727646677) / z. Does NOT apply to fragments. |
| `modifications` | `object[]` | — | never | {one\_based\_residue, terminus, id, mass, formal\_charge} per modification: one\_based\_residue is 1-based within the PEPTIDE and null for a terminal modification, which sets terminus 'N' or 'C' instead (terminus is null for a residue modification); id is mzLib's IdWithMotif; mass is its monoisotopic mass in Da, never null for a loaded modification (mzLib keeps one only if it has a formula or a mass, and fills a missing mass from the formula); formal\_charge in elementary charges. |
| `fragments` | `object[]` | — | never | {product\_type, fragment\_number, neutral\_mass, neutral\_loss, residue\_position} per ion: product\_type e.g. b, y, c, zDot; fragment\_number the position in its series; neutral\_mass the monoisotopic NEUTRAL mass in Da (not an m/z; no proton added); neutral\_loss in Da (0 when none); residue\_position 1-based within the peptide. |

# Errors

| Kind | mzLibRust returns | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`MzLibError::Usage`](crate::MzLibError::Usage) | accession missing or blank; UniProt answers 400 or 404 (no such entry); the entry holds no protein sequence; protease not in ProteaseDictionary; dissociation or terminus not an enum name; an integer option that is not an integer |
| `service_unavailable` | [`MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable`](crate::MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable) | UniProt unreachable by the bridge's own classification: a timeout (HttpClient 100 s), a socket or TLS failure, a request that never got a response, an HTTP 408, 429 or 5xx, or a body cut off in transit |
| `correctness` | [`MzLibError::Bridge`](crate::MzLibError::Bridge) | any other UniProt status (e.g. 403); UniProt's ptmlist.txt or PSI-MOD.obo.xml missing from the bridge payload (FileNotFoundException: every protein would otherwise look unmodified or carry wrong charges); mzLib failing to parse the entry or to digest it |

Any call can also fail on the way to mzLib or back, whatever the verb: [`MzLibError::BridgeNotFound`](crate::MzLibError::BridgeNotFound), [`MzLibError::Timeout`](crate::MzLibError::Timeout), [`MzLibError::Protocol`](crate::MzLibError::Protocol) or [`MzLibError::Io`](crate::MzLibError::Io).

# Caveats

- UniProt annotates more than mzLib applies: only 'modified residue' and 'lipid moiety-binding region' features load. Serum albumin: 14 of 38 annotated features applied, the 24 glycosylation-site features dropped on type (mzLib\#1112). Read uniprot\_features\_by\_type and unresolved\_modifications before trusting a modification count.
- max-isoforms truncates silently in mzLib. Histone H3.1 at four modifications keeps 8,644 of its 12,808 peptidoforms at the default cap of 1024, losing about a third. Check peptides\_at\_isoform\_cap before treating the list as exhaustive.
- Duplicate peptidoforms that mzLib's Digest emits where a chain boundary meets the initiator-Met cleavage site (mzLib\#1108, open) are collapsed by the bridge on (start, end, full sequence).
- Fragment masses are neutral. Converting one to m/z needs the fixed charge within that fragment's span, which the wire does not report; fixed\_charges is whole-peptide only.
- ETD's zDot ions are suppressed N-terminal to proline while the complementary c ions are not, leaving about 4% of the c series unobservable (mzLib\#1110).
- Needs the network: UniProt is queried on every call.
